title: LARecomp dependency kits
description: Pinned third-party files. The URL is an archive when zip_sha256 is present and a base URL for individual files otherwise. Paths are relative to the kit root, and a missing group condition means the group can be used on any host.

gpu_vendor.description: With `gpu_name`: the vendor word (machine.json gpu.vendor) an adapter must have. No `gpu_vendor`: any vendor.

gpu_name.description: Which graphics adapters the group is for, by name, so that the launcher's first setup can leave a group out before the game has ever run (nothing of the game can run before its dependencies are fetched; `when` is about the PC, this is about each adapter in it). A pattern in a small subset of regular expression syntax that every reader supports the same way: letters, digits, spaces, | * + ? and [ ] - only (no groups, anchors, escapes or counted repeats). It is searched anywhere in the adapter's name, ignoring case, and the adapter must also have `gpu_vendor` where the group names one. A kit's `core` group says which adapters use the kit at all; `frame_generation` (read together with `core`, for the same adapter) says which can use frame generation. No `gpu_name`: the group is not narrowed by adapter. The pattern and the vendor must give the same answers as the name tests of the game's own code (src/gpu/dlss_rr_rules.h NameLooksLikeRtx, src/gpu/dlss_fg_card.h NameLooksLikeFrameGeneration) on documentation/contract/adapter-name-vectors.json: larecomp_dlss_card_table_test and cmake/tests/install_manifest_test.py check it.
